exposure: Gestational diabetes mellitus group vs. no gestational diabetes mellitus group
outcome: Percentage reduction in clot lysis after 30 min
cohort: 182 antenatal Chinese women (50 with gestational diabetes mellitus and 132 without)
finding: Gestational diabetes mellitus is significantly associated with hypercoagulability and hyperfibrinolysis in antenatal Chinese women.
mod_finding: The prevalence of cesarean delivery was significantly higher in the gestational diabetes mellitus group compared to the no gestational diabetes mellitus group (56.0% vs. 37.9%, p = .027).
